user.title: Set up Aufgabenplaner
user.description: Aufgabenplaner will be set up. You manage people, lists and tasks afterwards directly in the dashboard card.

add_task.name: Add task
add_task.description: Creates a new task, optionally recurring.

list.name: List
list.description: List name. Default: first shared list.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Icon name, e.g. watering-can, vacuum, broom or paw.

complete_task.name: Complete task
complete_task.description: Checks off an open task and awards the stars.

list.name: List
list.description: Optional, if the title exists more than once.

person.name: Person

adjust_stars.name: Adjust stars
adjust_stars.description: Adds or removes stars manually, e.g. to redeem them.
